tip6.title: Krismas bilong lusim susu bilong ol liklikholda
tip6.content: Lusim susu bilong ol pikinini buai long 28 i go inap 35 de na noken mekim pastaim. Dispela i larim ol liklik buai long gro strong na lain long kisim strongpela kaikai long yusim ol liklik samting bilong fam.

tip7.title: Rot bilong brukim isi isi
tip7.content: Daunim hevi bilong 'weaning' long rot bilong rausim 'sow' long banis bilong karim pikinini na larim ol pikinini bulmakau i stap long ples we ol i save long en long namba wan wik.

tip8.title: Draf Prevensen bilong ol Weaners
tip8.content: Pasin bilong pasim kol win insait long banis bilong ol pikinini long rot bilong putim ol keten o ol diwai bod inap long mak bilong pikinini buai (olsem 50cm).

tip11.title: Solusen bilong kisim bek wara long haus
tip11.content: Givim wanpela liklik pe, hommeid electrolyte solusen (5 spun suga, 1/2 spun sol insait long 5 lita klinpela wara) long namba wan 3 de bilong lusim susu long daunim hevi.

tip17.title: Clay Soil Mineral Supplement
tip17.content: Putim wanpela klinpela 'shovel' bilong nupela, retpela graun (i kam long wanpela klinpela hap) insait long banis bilong karim bebi. Ol liklik buai i save kaikai dispela bilong kisim ain na mineral.

tip20.title: Boiling bilong ol samting bilong egrikalsa
tip20.content: Boilim ol samting bilong egrikalsa olsem skin bilong yam, skin bilong maniok, na poteto rop bilong bagarapim ol marasin nogut na mekim gutpela kaikai.

tip21.title: Ol Lokal Protin Sos
tip21.content: Givim kaikai bilong ol bisnis long groim ol kaikai we i gat planti protin olsem Moringa, Azolla, o ol lip bilong swit poteto long fam.

tip22.title: Tambuim kaikai bilong meri i gat bel
tip22.content: Larim ol bulmakau meri i gat bel long kisim 2-2.5 kg kaikai long wan wan de bilong stopim ol long kamap patpela tumas, we i save kamapim hevi long karim pikinini.

tip26.title: Boilim ol pipia bilong haus kuk
tip26.content: Boilim ol pipia bilong kaikai bilong hotel o haus kuk inap 30 minit long bagarapim ol vairas bilong Afrikan Swine Fiva na sik bilong lek na maus.

tip28.title: Jakol bilong daunim kaikai
tip28.content: Putim ol liklik hap sit bilong paiawut insait long ol 'grower pen'. Ol buai i save kaikaim bilong helpim long pasim ol marasin nogut long bel na daunim pekpek wara.

tip34.title: Hand Mating insait long Breeding Pen
tip34.content: Bringim buai long hat i go long banis bilong buai bilong karim pikinini, na noken larim buai i ran nating insait long lain buai.

tip35.title: Standing Heat Response
tip35.content: Testim hat long rot bilong presim han bilong yu strong long baksait bilong buai; sapos em i sanap isi na pasim yau bilong em, em i redi long poroman.

tip43.title: Kalenda bilong ol rekot bilong karim pikinini
tip43.content: Makim de bilong karim pikinini long kalenda; bel i save stap inap 114 de (3-pela mun, 3-pela wik, 3-pela de), na dispela i larim yu long redim ples bilong karim pikinini.

tip47.title: Gilt Fes Mating Age
tip47.content: Wet inap long wanpela 'gilt' i gat 8-pela mun na i stap long namba tu o namba tri 'heat cycle' bilong em pastaim long yu bungim em long kisim bikpela namba wan pikinini.

tip48.title: Putim ol nupela samting yu baim
tip48.content: Putim ol nupela buai long wanpela seperet banis we i stap 20 mita longwe long bikpela lain buai bilong yu inap 30 de long sekim sapos ol i gat sik.

tip49.title: DIY Footbath Setup
tip49.content: Putim wanpela plastik tub we i no dip tumas o wanpela hap taia we i pulap long wara na marasin bilong kilim ol binatang (olsem klorin o laim bilong egrikalsa) long geit bilong fam.

tip51.title: Polisi bilong tambuim ol visita
tip51.content: Noken larim ol visita (espeseli ol narapela buai baia o fama) insait long banis bilong buai bilong yu. Toktok long bisnis ausait long pen eria.

tip55.title: Natural Parasite Control
tip55.content: Givim ol sid bilong papaya o sid bilong pamkin long ol buai olsem wanpela marasin we i no gat bikpela pe na i save helpim long daunim ol 'internal worm'.

tip60.title: Gutpela Beri bilong ol Daiman
tip60.content: Planim ol dai buai long 2 mita dip, longwe long ol wara, na karamapim bodi bilong ol wantaim 'agricultural lime' pastaim long pulimapim gen graun.

tip61.title: Pen spes we i no gat bikpela pe
tip61.content: Givim 1 skwea mita spes long wanwan pik bilong pinisim pait bilong daunim pait, stres, na ol sua long skin.

tip62.title: Natural Cross-Ventilation
tip62.content: Disainim ol haus bilong buai wantaim ol sait i op (yusim ol 'wire mesh' o 'bamboo slats') long larim win i kam insait na rausim ol smel.

tip75.title: DIY Kompost Piles
tip75.content: Putim pekpek bilong buai long wanpela kona we i drai, karamapim wantaim lip banana o plastik, na tanim long olgeta wik wantaim sovel long wokim kompos.

tip76.title: Fleksibel Beg Biogas
tip76.content: Putim wanpela simpol, liklik plastik 'tubular biogas digester' bilong klinim pekpek bilong buai, na kamapim fri ges bilong kukim kaikai bilong hauslain.

tip92.title: Krismas bilong 'castration'
tip92.content: Kastretim ol pikinini buai man pastaim long ol i gat 7-pela de. Long dispela krismas, dispela wok i save kamap hariap, i save orait hariap, na i no save givim planti pen.

tip94.title: Ol isipela notbuk rekot
tip94.content: Kipim wanpela liklik, jip notbuk insait long haus bulmakau bilong raitim ol deit bilong karim pikinini, ol deit bilong karim pikinini, na ol tritmen bilong wanwan bulmakau meri.

dis_ppv.description: As bilong hevi bilong karim pikinini long ol 'gilts'.
dis_ppv.prevention: Givim sut pastaim long karim pikinini.

dis_rhinitis.name: Atrophic Rhinitis
dis_rhinitis.description: I save mekim maus i paul na i gat hevi long pulim win.

dis_leptospirosis.name: Leptospirosis
dis_leptospirosis.description: Sik bilong ol binatang jem we i save bagarapim ol kidni.
dis_leptospirosis.prevention: Kontrolim ol rat na givim sut.

dis_influenza.name: Swine Influenza
dis_influenza.description: Sik bilong pulim win we i save kalap hariap.

dis_edema.name: Sik bilong Edema
dis_edema.description: Em i kamap long ol marasin nogut bilong E. coli long ol liklik buai we ol i lusim susu.

dis_dysentery.name: Swine Disentery
dis_dysentery.prevention: Wara marasin na kilim ol binatang.

dis_mange.name: Sarcoptic Mange
dis_mange.description: Sik bilong skin we i save kamapim bikpela pen.

dis_anemia.name: Sot long Ain Anemia
dis_anemia.description: Em i save kamap long ol liklik buai insait long haus we i no gat ol marasin bilong ain.
dis_anemia.prevention: Ol sut bilong ain taim pikinini i bon.

dis_ulcers.name: Ol sua long bel
dis_ulcers.description: Em i kamap long gutpela kaikai o hevi.
dis_ulcers.prevention: Stretim sais bilong ol liklik hap kaikai.

dis_pss.name: Porcine Stress Syndrome
dis_pss.description: Jenetik kondisen we i kamap long hevi.
dis_pss.prevention: Jenetik seleksen na pasin bilong lukautim gut.

dis_tge.name: Transmisible Gastroenteritis (TGE)
dis_tge.description: Sik bilong vaires we i save kilim planti liklik buai.

dis_strep.name: Streptococcus suis
dis_strep.description: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem we i save kamapim sik 'meningitis'.

dis_mycotoxicosis.name: Mycotoxicosis
dis_mycotoxicosis.description: Em i kamap long kaikai we i gat 'mold' long en.
dis_mycotoxicosis.prevention: Ol samting bilong pasim marasin nogut na drai stoa.

dis_greasy_pig.name: Sik bilong pik i gat gris
dis_greasy_pig.description: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem we i save kamapim ol sua long skin.
dis_greasy_pig.prevention: Senitesen na ol marasin bilong kilim ol binatang jem.

dis_pseudorabies.name: Pseudorabies (bilong Aujeszky)
dis_pseudorabies.description: Sik bilong vaires we i save bagarapim ol 'nervous' na 'respiratory system'.
dis_pseudorabies.prevention: Ol program bilong givim sut na pinisim sik.

dis_pcv2.name: Porcine Circovirus (PCV2)
dis_pcv2.description: I save kamapim hevi long westim na pulim win long ol groa.

dis_ped.name: Porcine Epidemic Diarrhea (PED)
dis_ped.description: Wankain olsem TGE, em i save kilim planti bebi.

dis_je.name: Japanese Encephalitis
dis_je.prevention: Kontrolim ol moskito na givim sut.

dis_rabies.name: Rabies
dis_rabies.description: Sik bilong vaires we i save kilim man i save kamap long ol man i kaikaim man.
dis_rabies.prevention: Givim sut long ol animal bilong haus na kontrolim ol wel animal.

dis_pox.name: Swine Pox
dis_pox.description: Sik bilong skin we i save kamap long ol binatang jem, planti taim ol liklik binatang i save kalap long en.

dis_vs.name: Vesicular Stomatitis
dis_vs.description: I save kamapim ol sua; i luk olsem FMD.
dis_vs.prevention: Kontrol bilong ol binatang na kwarentin.

dis_clostridial.name: Clostridial Enteritis
dis_clostridial.description: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem i save bagarapim tru bel.
dis_clostridial.prevention: Givim sut long ol bulmakau meri na klinim bodi.

dis_glassers.name: Sik bilong Glasser
dis_glassers.description: I save kamapim sua long ol 'membrane' klostu long bel, lewa, na ol join.

dis_ileitis.name: Ileitis (Lawsonia)
dis_ileitis.description: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem long liklik 'intestine'.

dis_tb.name: Tibi
dis_tb.description: Sik bilong ol baktiria we i save stap longpela taim.
dis_tb.prevention: Pasin bilong pasim ol pisin na klinim ples.

dis_tetanus.name: Tetanus
dis_tetanus.description: Posin bilong ol binatang jem we i save bagarapim 'nervous system'.
dis_tetanus.prevention: Klinpela samting long taim bilong operesen/kastresen.

dis_eperythrozoonosis.name: Eperythrozoonosis
dis_eperythrozoonosis.description: Blut binatang i save kamapim sik 'anemia'.
dis_eperythrozoonosis.prevention: Kontrolim ol binatang na klinim ol nil.

dis_ascaris.name: Ascaris suum
dis_ascaris.description: Ol binatang nogut insait long bodi i save bagarapim lewa na lewa.

dis_whipworms.name: Ol wipwom
dis_whipworms.description: Insait long 'internal parasite' insait long bikpela 'intestine'.
dis_whipworms.prevention: Rausim ol binatang na klinim ples.

dis_kidney_worms.name: Kidni Worm
dis_kidney_worms.description: Ol binatang jem insait long bodi i save bagarapim ol kidni na leva.

dis_lice.name: Swine Lice
dis_lice.description: Ol binatang nogut i save pulim blut.
dis_lice.prevention: Tritmen bilong marasin bilong kilim ol binatang.

dis_ringworm.name: Ringworm
dis_ringworm.description: Sik long skin we i save kamap long ol binatang jem.

dis_mulberry_heart.name: Mulberi Hat Sik
dis_mulberry_heart.description: Sot long kaikai i save bagarapim bel.

dis_rickets.name: Rickets
dis_rickets.description: Sot long kaikai i save bagarapim gro bilong bun.
dis_rickets.prevention: Ol mineral na sanlait i stap gut.

dis_salt_poisoning.name: Sol Poisin
dis_salt_poisoning.description: Em i kamap bikos i no gat wara na bihain ol i dring planti tumas.

dis_heat_stroke.name: Hat Strok
dis_heat_stroke.description: I hat tumas bikos i no gat gutpela win o sedo.

dis_rectal_prolapse.name: Rectal Prolapse
dis_rectal_prolapse.description: Planti taim i save kamap bihain long kus, pekpek wara, o kol.
dis_rectal_prolapse.prevention: Lukluk long namba wan as na operesen.

dis_splayleg.name: Splayleg
dis_splayleg.description: Ol liklik pik i bon na ol i no inap sanap wantaim baksait lek.

dis_vulvovaginitis.name: Vulvovaginitis
dis_vulvovaginitis.description: Em i kamap long ol 'estrogenic fungal toxins' insait long kaikai.

dis_seneca.name: Seneca Valley Virus (SVV)
dis_seneca.description: I save kamapim ol sua wankain olsem FMD.

dis_deltacoronavirus.name: Porcine Deltacoronavirus
dis_deltacoronavirus.description: Viral pekpek wara long olgeta krismas.

dis_rotavirus.name: Rotavirus Diarrhea
dis_rotavirus.description: As bilong pekpek wara taim em i lusim susu.

dis_vesicular.name: Sik bilong ol rop bilong buai
dis_vesicular.description: Sik bilong vaires i wankain olsem FMD.

dis_melioidosis.name: Melioidosis
dis_melioidosis.description: Sik bilong ol binatang jem i kam long graun/wara.

dis_trypanosomiasis.name: Trypanosomiasis
dis_trypanosomiasis.description: Sik bilong ol 'protozoan' we ol 'tsetse' flai i save kalap long en.

dis_cysticercosis.name: Cysticercosis
dis_cysticercosis.description: Larval stej bilong human tapeworm insait long masol bilong buai.
dis_cysticercosis.prevention: Stopim rot bilong kisim ol pipia bilong ol man.

dis_listeriosis.name: Listeriosis
dis_listeriosis.description: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem long 'nervous system'.

dis_ear_necrosis.name: Yau Nekrosis
dis_ear_necrosis.description: Planti taim dispela i save kamap bikos long hevi, planti manmeri tumas, o sik.
dis_ear_necrosis.prevention: Daunim density na tritim seken infeksen.

dis_sunburn.name: San i kukim
dis_sunburn.description: I save bagarapim ol buai i gat waitpela skin ausait.

dis_tail_biting.name: Katim Tel
dis_tail_biting.description: Hevi bilong pasin bikos long stres/les.
dis_tail_biting.prevention: Daunim hevi na mekim envairomen i kamap gutpela.

dis_navel_ill.name: Navel Ill
dis_navel_ill.description: Infeksen long rop bilong bel taim pikinini i bon.
dis_navel_ill.prevention: Iodine dip long taim bilong karim pikinini na senitesen.

dis_iron_toxicity.name: Posin bilong ain
dis_iron_toxicity.description: Em inap kamap sapos ol i sutim ain long ol liklik buai we i sot long Vit E.
dis_iron_toxicity.prevention: Mekim gut olsem kaikai bilong ol bulmakau i gat gutpela mak.

dis_aflatoxicosis.name: Aflatoxicosis
dis_aflatoxicosis.description: Toksin poisin i kam long ol wit o kaikai i gat 'mold' na dispela i save bagarapim 'liver' na 'jaundice'.
dis_aflatoxicosis.prevention: Noken givim ol kaikai i gat 'mold', putim ol wit samting long ples we i drai, na yusim ol marasin bilong pasim marasin nogut.

dis_parakeratosis.name: Parakeratosis (Zinc Deficiency)
dis_parakeratosis.description: Sik bilong kaikai i save kamapim ol bikpela sua long skin.
dis_parakeratosis.prevention: Mekim gutpela mak bilong 'calcium-to-zinc' insait long kaikai na givim ol 'zinc suplement'.

dis_biotin_deficiency.name: Sot long Biotin
dis_biotin_deficiency.description: Sapos man i sot long kaikai, dispela i save mekim na lek bilong lek i bruk, skin i gat sua, na lek nogut.
dis_biotin_deficiency.prevention: Givim 'biotin' long kaikai na abrusim ol simen plua we i no strong tumas.

dis_gossypol_toxicity.name: Posin bilong Gossypol
dis_gossypol_toxicity.description: Poisin i kamap taim man i kaikai 'raw' o planti 'cottonseed', na dispela i save kamapim hevi long pulim win.
dis_gossypol_toxicity.prevention: Noken kaikai planti 'cottonseed' na yusim 'iron sulfate' long daunim 'gossypol'.

dis_cassava_poisoning.name: Poisin bilong maniok
dis_cassava_poisoning.description: Posin bilong 'cyanide' long ol rop o skin bilong maniok we ol i no bin kukim o ol i no bin prosesim gut.
dis_cassava_poisoning.prevention: Rausim skin bilong maniok, boilim, draim long san, o mekim maniok i kamap strong pastaim long yu givim kaikai.

dis_sweet_potato_toxicity.name: Posin bilong swit poteto
dis_sweet_potato_toxicity.description: Poisin i kam long ol swit poteto we i gat 'mold', na dispela i save kamapim bikpela hevi long pulim win.
dis_sweet_potato_toxicity.prevention: Tromoi ol swit poteto we i bagarap o i gat 'mold'; givim ol helti rop tasol.

dis_mma.name: Postpartum Dysgalactia (MMA)
dis_mma.description: Mastitis, metritis, na agalactia i save kamapim fiva na sot long susu long ol bulmakau meri bihain long ol i karim pikinini.
dis_mma.prevention: Lukautim gutpela pasin bilong lukautim banis bilong ol bulmakau na mekim gutpela kaikai long ol bulmakau.

dis_pwd.name: Pekpek wara bihain long lusim susu (PWD)
dis_pwd.description: Pekpek wara i save kamap long ol liklik buai bihain liklik long ol i lusim susu, na dispela i save mekim ol i sot long wara.
dis_pwd.prevention: Daunim hevi bilong lusim susu, lukautim gutpela klinim ples, na givim klinpela wara bilong dring.

dis_trichinellosis.name: Trichinellosis
dis_trichinellosis.description: Sik bilong ol animal we i save kamap taim man i kaikai ol hap mit we i no kukim yet, na dispela i save mekim ol masol i kamap strong.
dis_trichinellosis.prevention: Noken givim kaikai long ol 'swill', boilim ol hap kaikai inap 30 minit, na bosim ol rat.

dis_hydatid_disease.name: Hydatidosis
dis_hydatid_disease.description: Infeksen bilong ol 'parasitic larval' we i save kamapim ol 'cyst' we i pulap long wara insait long ol bodi bodi.
dis_hydatid_disease.prevention: Yu mas rausim ol 'worm' long ol dok bilong fam oltaim na pasim ol long kaikai ol 'raw organ' bilong buai.

dis_phe.name: Porcine Hemorrhagic Enteropathy
dis_phe.description: Bikpela pekpek wara na dai wantu tasol long ol buai we i save groim/pinis.
dis_phe.prevention: Lukautim gutpela ples bilong klinim na yusim ol stretpela marasin bilong kilim jem aninit long stia bilong dokta bilong ol animal.

dis_mycoplasma_arthritis.name: Mycoplasmal Arthritis
dis_mycoplasma_arthritis.description: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem we i save mekim ol join i solap, lek nogut, na lek i no strong.
dis_mycoplasma_arthritis.prevention: Mekim gutpela sindaun bilong haus, daunim namba bilong ol animal, na tritim hariap.

dis_foot_rot.name: Rot bilong lek (Necrobacillosis)
dis_foot_rot.description: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem i go insait long ol bagarap long lek, na i save mekim lek i bagarap na lek nogut.
dis_foot_rot.prevention: Stretim ol simen we i no gutpela, larim plua i stap drai, na yusim ol ples bilong waswas long lek sapos i gat nid.

dis_babesiosis.name: Tik-borne Babesiosis
dis_babesiosis.description: Blut binatang we i save kalap long ol 'tick' na i save kamapim bikpela fiva, 'anemia', na blakpela pispis.
dis_babesiosis.prevention: Kontrolim ol tik yusim ol marasin bilong kilim ol tik na larim ol banis i no gat ol diwai na gras.

dis_anaplasmosis.name: Anaplasmosis
dis_anaplasmosis.description: Ol sik we i save kamap long ol binatang jem we i save kamapim 'anemia', fiva, na 'jaundice'.

dis_sow_hysteria.name: Sow Hysteria
dis_sow_hysteria.description: Hevi bilong pasin we ol buai i save karim pikinini i save kros na kaikaim ol pikinini buai.
dis_sow_hysteria.prevention: Givim wanpela kwaet ples bilong karim pikinini, lukautim ol 'gilt', na yusim ol marasin bilong daunim bel hevi sapos i gat nid.

dis_thorny_headed_worm.name: Wom i gat nil het
dis_thorny_headed_worm.description: Ol 'parasitic worm' i save kisim taim ol i kaikaim ol 'beetle', na dispela i save kamapim hul long bel.
dis_thorny_headed_worm.prevention: Noken lukautim fri long ol graun we i gat ol 'beetle' na yusim ol marasin bilong rausim ol binatang jem.

dis_strongyloidiasis.name: Strongyloidiasis (Threadworm)
dis_strongyloidiasis.description: Intestinal threadworm i save kamapim bikpela pekpek wara na dai long ol pikinini buai.
dis_strongyloidiasis.prevention: Larim ol bokis bilong karim pikinini i drai na klin, na rausim ol binatang jem pastaim long karim pikinini.

dis_hyostrongylosis.name: Retpela Bel Wom
dis_hyostrongylosis.description: Sik bilong 'stomach worm' we i save kamapim sik 'gastritis', 'anemia', na 'weight loss'.
dis_hyostrongylosis.prevention: Senisim ol gras, mekim haus i stap drai, na bihainim wanpela sediul bilong rausim ol binatang nogut.

dis_oesophagostomiasis.name: Nodular Worm Infeksen
dis_oesophagostomiasis.description: Intestinal parasit i save kamapim ol nodul long wol bilong bel, na dispela i save mekim ol bulmakau i kamap liklik.
dis_oesophagostomiasis.prevention: Oltaim klinim pen na yusim ol bikpela marasin bilong kilim ol binatang.

dis_fascioliasis.name: Fascioliasis (Liver Fluke)
dis_fascioliasis.description: Parasitic fluke i save bagarapim 'liver', we i save kamap long ol ples we i gat wara o ples tais.
dis_fascioliasis.prevention: Pasim ol buai long kaikai gras long ol ples we i gat planti tais na kontrolim ol 'mud snail'.

dis_emcv.name: Encephalomyocarditis (EMCV)
dis_emcv.description: Viral infeksen we i save kamap long ol rat na i save mekim hat i no wok gut na rausim bel.
dis_emcv.prevention: Mekim strongpela wok bilong bosim ol rat na lukautim kaikai bilong ol long ol binatang nogut.

dis_demodectic_mange.name: Demodex Mange
dis_demodectic_mange.description: Skin mite we i no klia tumas na i save kamapim ol liklik mak na ol liklik 'pustules'.
dis_demodectic_mange.prevention: Mekim gutpela kaikai bilong ol animal, rausim ol buai i gat sik, na putim marasin bilong kilim ol buai.

dis_pityriasis_rosea.name: Pityriasis Rosea
dis_pityriasis_rosea.description: Skin we i no inap kalap long ol narapela long ol yangpela buai we i save kamapim ol 'ring-like crusts'.
dis_pityriasis_rosea.prevention: Planti taim em i save stretim hevi bilong em yet; lukautim klinpela, draipela bet na daunim hevi.

dis_photosensitization.name: Photosensitization
dis_photosensitization.description: Bikpela san i save kamap long ol buai i gat waitpela skin bihain long ol i kaikai sampela kain diwai.
dis_photosensitization.prevention: Givim sedo, rausim ol gras nogut we i save mekim ol i kisim sik, na putim ol buai insait long haus.

dis_shoulder_ulcers.name: Sow Solda Ulcers
dis_shoulder_ulcers.description: Ol sua i stap long solda bilong ol liklik bulmakau meri we i stap antap long strongpela simen.
dis_shoulder_ulcers.prevention: Givim ol malumalum bet, lukautim ol bulmakau long gutpela bodi, na yusim ol mat bilong raba.

dis_ear_biting.name: Pasin bilong kaikai man long yau
dis_ear_biting.description: Nogut pasin we ol buai i save kaikaim yau bilong ol poroman bilong ol, na dispela i save kamapim sik 'necrosis'.
dis_ear_biting.prevention: Daunim pasin bilong bungim planti manmeri, mekim win i kam insait gut, na givim ol samting olsem ol sen.

dis_gastric_torsion.name: Gastric Torsion (Bloat)
dis_gastric_torsion.description: Bel i pulap na i tantanim wantu tasol, na dispela i mekim na man i dai hariap.
dis_gastric_torsion.prevention: Noken givim bikpela kaikai bihain long yu tambu long kaikai longpela taim na brukim kaikai bilong olgeta de i go long ol liklik hap.

dis_c_difficile.name: Clostridium difficile (CDI)
dis_c_difficile.description: Infeksen bilong ol binatang jem long ol nupela pikinini buai i save kamapim pekpek wara na bel i solap.
dis_c_difficile.prevention: Klinim na kilim ol jem gut long ol banis bilong ol bebi na mekim 'colostrum' i kamap hariap.

dis_cold_stress.name: Kol Stres (Hypothermia)
dis_cold_stress.description: Bikpela kol bilong bodi bilong ol pikinini buai, na dispela i save mekim ol i guria na planti i save dai.
dis_cold_stress.prevention: Givim ol 'heat lamp', ol 'creep box', na mekim ples bilong karim pikinini i drai na i no gat win.

dis_necrotic_enteritis.name: Nekrotik Enteritis
dis_necrotic_enteritis.description: Sik bilong ol binatang jem we i save kamapim bikpela pekpek wara na planti pikinini buai i save dai.
dis_necrotic_enteritis.prevention: Givim sut long ol bulmakau meri pastaim long ol i karim pikinini na lukautim gut banis.

dis_navel_bleeding.name: Blut i kapsait long nus
dis_navel_bleeding.description: Planti blut i save ron long 'umbilical cord' bilong ol nupela pikinini buai.
dis_navel_bleeding.prevention: Pasim rop bilong bel taim pikinini i bon na noken givim kaikai i gat 'mycotoxin' long ol bulmakau meri.

dis_spirochetal_colitis.name: Porcine Spirochetal Colitis
dis_spirochetal_colitis.description: Sik bilong pekpek wara i no bikpela tumas long ol buai i wok long gro, na i save mekim ol i no kisim gutpela hevi.
dis_spirochetal_colitis.prevention: Klinim ol ples bilong kaikai na givim marasin bilong kilim ol buai long ol buai i gat sik.

dis_salmonella_septicemia.name: Salmonella Septicemia
dis_salmonella_septicemia.description: Bikpela sik salmonella long blut we i save kamapim pepol skin na dai hariap.
dis_salmonella_septicemia.prevention: Putim ol sik buai i stap wanpis, givim marasin wara, na lukautim gut 'biosecurity'.

dis_prdc.name: Porcine Respiratory Disease Complex
dis_prdc.description: Ol sik bilong pulim win we i save kamap long ol vaires na baktiria we i save mekim man i kus na i no gro gut.
dis_prdc.prevention: Mekim gutpela rot bilong pulim win, noken pulap tumas, na bosim ol namba wan vaires.

dis_ergotism.name: Ergot Poisoning (Ergotism)
dis_ergotism.description: Posin bilong ol 'fungal' long ol 'serial greins' we i gat sik 'ergot', na dispela i save kamapim bagarap long ol 'tissue necrosis'.
dis_ergotism.prevention: Skrinim ol kaikai bilong kaikai long ol 'dark ergot body' na senisim ol kaikai we i gat doti long en.

dis_bvdv_pig.name: BVDV Infeksen long ol buai
dis_bvdv_pig.description: Bovine Viral Diarrhea vaires infeksen taim man i bungim ol bulmakau, na dispela i mekim na ol i rausim bel.
dis_bvdv_pig.prevention: Putim ol pik i stap longwe long ol bulmakau na sipsip, na tambuim ol 'crossspecies' kontek.

dis_endocarditis.name: Bacterial Endocarditis
dis_endocarditis.description: Het valv infeksen i save mekim hat i no wok gut na dai wantu tasol long taim bilong hevi.
dis_endocarditis.prevention: Tritim hariap ol sik na sua long ol join, na makim ol 'genetics' we inap long kisim sik.

dis_polyserositis.name: Mycoplasma Polyserositis
dis_polyserositis.description: 'Fibrinous inflammation' bilong 'lung', 'heart', na ol 'joint surfaces' bilong ol 'weaners'.
dis_polyserositis.prevention: Daunim hevi bilong lusim susu, noken miksim ol pikinini, na givim gutpela win.

dis_congenital_tremor.name: Congenital Tremor
dis_congenital_tremor.description: Neurological kondisen long ol nupela pikinini buai i save mekim ol i guria nogut tru.
dis_congenital_tremor.prevention: Noken yusim wara bilong ol 'boar' we i gat sik na daunim hevi bilong 'sow' taim em i gat bel.

Symptoms.criticalBiosecurityDesc: High-confidence clinical match detected for legally notifiable disease: {disease} ({percent}% match).
Symptoms.emergencyContainmentProtocolSteps:
1. 🔒 Immediate Quarantine: Seal affected pen immediately; restrict personnel access.
2. 🚫 Movement Freeze: Cease all live pig, pork, feed, and manure shipments off-farm.
3. 🧼 Disinfect: Deploy boot baths & tyre dips with Virkon S or 2% caustic soda.
4. 📞 Mandatory Reporting: Contact your District Veterinary Officer immediately.
5. ⚠️ No Slaughter: Do not slaughter sick or suspect animals for meat.
Symptoms.otherSignsWatch: Ol narapela sain yu mas was gut long en:
Symptoms.bio_proto_asf: IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY QUARANTINE: African Swine Fever is a lethal, legally notifiable virus. 1) Lock down farm gates immediately. 2) Stop all movement of pigs, vehicles, feed, and manure. 3) Disinfect all boot baths and tyres with Virkon S or 2% caustic soda. 4) Contact your District/National Veterinary Officer immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_fmd: NOTIFIABLE EPIDEMIC ALERT: Foot-and-Mouth Disease spreads rapidly through aerosols and equipment. 1) Quarantine suspect pen immediately. 2) No live pigs or personnel movement off-site. 3) Setup tyre baths and boot dips with approved disinfectant. 4) Notify livestock authorities immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_csf: NOTIFIABLE DISEASE ALERT: Classical Swine Fever (Hog Cholera). 1) Restrict pen access and isolate suspect animals. 2) Halt all pig sales and shipments. 3) Wear dedicated boots/overalls. 4) Report to official state veterinary services immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_anthrax: DANGER - ZOONOTIC EMERGENCY: Bacillus anthracis can infect humans. 1) DO NOT OPEN CARCASSES (exposure to air causes resistant spores). 2) Isolate surviving pigs. 3) Wear full PPE. 4) Call veterinary authorities for safe incineration or deep burial with quicklime.
Symptoms.bio_proto_pseudorabies: NOTIFIABLE HERPESVIRUS ALERT: Pseudorabies / Aujeszky's causes severe neurological fatality in piglets. 1) Strict pen quarantine. 2) Control wild animals and rodents. 3) Notify state veterinary authorities immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_rabies: FATAL ZOONOTIC ALERT: Rabies transmits to humans through saliva and bites. 1) DO NOT HANDLE PIG WITH BARE HANDS. 2) Secure pen tightly. 3) Alert veterinary and public health authorities immediately.
Symptoms.bio_proto_vesicular_stomatitis: REPORTABLE VESICULAR LESION ALERT: Vesicular Stomatitis is clinically indistinguishable from Foot and Mouth Disease. 1) Isolate infected pigs immediately. 2) Wear protective gloves. 3) Report to state veterinarian for lab differential diagnosis.
Symptoms.bio_proto_senecavirus: REPORTABLE VESICULAR DISEASE: Senecavirus A lesions are clinically indistinguishable from Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). 1) Quarantine pen immediately. 2) Restrict off-farm movement. 3) Notify livestock veterinary authorities for mandatory differential PCR testing.
Symptoms.bio_proto_svd: REPORTABLE VESICULAR DISEASE: Swine Vesicular Disease (SVD). 1) Strict isolation of infected animals. 2) Restrict all vehicle and visitor movements. 3) Report to state animal health department immediately.

s1.title: 1. Akseptim ol tok orait
s1.content: Taim yu yusim na yusim SmartSwine ap, yu wanbel long bihainim ol dispela Lo bilong Sevis. Sapos yu no wanbel long ol dispela tok orait, plis noken yusim dispela sevis.

s2.title: 2. Diskripsen bilong Sevis
s2.content:
"SmartSwine" i save givim ol tul bilong lukautim fam we i gat, tasol i no inap long:
• Traking bilong ol animal na helt data.
• Kipim ol rekot bilong mani.
• Human Risos menesmen.
• Ol tingting bilong painimaut sik we AI i helpim.
• Infomesen bilong kisim maket.

s3.title: 3. Data Praivesi na Klaut Bekap
s3.content:
Yu holim yet onasip bilong ol data yu putim (ol data bilong ol animal, ol fainensel, na ol narapela samting). 
Ol data bilong fam bilong yu i stap gut tru long Google Firebase, taim mipela i wok long lukautim data bilong yu, mipela i no inap long givim gutpela sekyuriti. 
Taim yu opim Cloud Backup, yu orait long ol i ken putim na stretim ol data bilong yu long ol divais bilong yu. 
Mipela i no save salim ol pesonel o fam data bilong yu i go long ol narapela lain.
Yu yet i gat wok long lukautim stretpela bilong ol data yu putim. Ol data we i no stret insait long "Feed" o "Financials" modul i ken kamapim ol rong kalkulesen.

s4.title: 4. Nogat Medikol o Veterineri Advais (Kritikel Diskleimer)
s4.content:
Ol samting bilong "Fed Calculator", "Fed Formulator", "Symptoms Analyzer" na "Disease Finder" em bilong skulim na givim infomesen tasol.
• Ol risal bilong AI i kamap long rot bilong ol 'algorithm' na i no inap long senisim edvais bilong ol dokta bilong ol animal, painimaut sik, o tritmen.
• Yusa i wanbel long toktok wantaim wanpela dokta bilong ol animal i gat laisens pastaim long em i mekim ol disisen long sait bilong kaikai na marasin bilong ol animal.
• Papa bilong dispela ap i no gat asua long ol animal i lus o bagarap i kamap long yusim bilong ap na ol samting bilong en.

s5.title: 5. Ol wok bilong yusa
s5.content: Ol yusa i gat wok long lukautim gut ol samting bilong akaun bilong ol. Yu gat asua long olgeta wok we i kamap aninit long akaun bilong yu.

s6.title: 6. Pasin we i tambu
s6.content:
Ol yusa i wanbel long noken:
• Yusim dispela ap long ol samting we i no stret long lo.
• Traim long senisim aplikesen.
• Putim ol giaman fainensel data bilong giamanim ol narapela lain.

s7.title: 7. Sevis i stap
s7.content: Mipela i wok long kisim 99% 'uptime' tasol mipela i no tok tru olsem yu no inap kisim sevis. Ol i givim ol 'data backup' bilong helpim yu; tasol, ol i strongim ol yusa long lukautim ol rekot bilong ol yet.

s8.title: 8. Limitesen bilong Laibiliti
s8.content: SmartSwine ap i stap "olsem em i stap." Long mak we lo i tok orait long en, ol divelopa bilong en bai no inap long kisim asua long ol bagarap we i kamap long yusim o no inap long yusim sevis, na tu, ol animal i lus o ol hevi bilong mani.

s9.title: 9. Fainensel Data
s9.content: "Financials" modul em i wanpela tul bilong bihainim na em i no wanpela profesenel akaunting o takis edvais. Ol i strongim ol yusa long salim ol data bilong ol i go aut long ol 'certified accountant' i ken glasim.

s10.title: 10. Ol senis long ol tok orait
s10.content: Mipela i gat rait long senisim ol dispela tok orait long wanem taim mipela i laikim. Sapos yu yusim yet dispela ap, dispela i makim olsem yu orait long ol nupela tok.

s11.title: 11. Kontak Infomesen
s11.content: Sapos yu laik kisim sapot o ol askim long sait bilong lo, plis yu ken toktok wantaim divelopa long rot bilong ol seting bilong profail bilong ap.

Guide.guide_breeding_step1_desc: Lukluk long 'standing reflex', 'vulva' i solap, na ol 'vocalizations'. Rekodim naturela sevis o AI wantaim ol ditel bilong 'boar tag'.
Guide.guide_breeding_step1_tip: Gutpela pasin em long givim kaikai long bulmakau tupela taim: 12-pela aua namel long tupela long taim bilong bikpela hat.
Guide.guide_breeding_step2_desc: SmartSwine i save sediulim ol 'heat check' gen long 18-24 de na ol 'farrowing alert' long 110-114 de.
Guide.guide_breeding_step2_tip: Sekim sapos em i go bek long hat klostu long De 21. Sapos 'sow' i soim hat i sanap, sevis gen hariap.
Guide.guide_breeding_step3_desc: Disinfektim ol bokis bilong karim pikinini na muvim ol meri i gat bel 4 i go inap 5-pela de pastaim long de bilong karim pikinini. Redim ol lam bilong hatim ol liklik buai.
Guide.guide_breeding_step3_tip: Larim hap we ol liklik pik i save stap long en i stap hat (30-32°C) long stopim 'hypothermia' long ol nupela bebi.
Guide.guide_breeding_step4_desc: Log Born Alive, Stillborns, Mummies, na Total Litter Birth Weight long skelim wok bilong mama bilong bulmakau.
Guide.guide_breeding_step4_tip: Givim ain injeksen na katim tit bilong nil insait long 24-48 aua bihain long taim mama i karim pikinini.
Guide.guide_breeding_subtitle: Trakim ol 'heat cycles' bilong ol 'sow', ol de bilong givim kaikai, 114-de 'gestation', na ol 'farrowing litters'.
Guide.guide_breeding_title: Ol taim bilong karim pikinini na karim pikinini
Guide.guide_feed_step1_desc: Go long 'Feed' na opim 'Feed Formulation' tul long wokim o stretim ol 'custom feeding rations'.
Guide.guide_feed_step1_tip: Sekim ol prais bilong ol samting bilong kukim kaikai pastaim long painimaut wanem kain protin na eneji i no gat bikpela pe tumas.
Guide.guide_feed_step2_desc: Yu mas makim 'target' buai stej (Krip, Stata, Growa, Pinisim, Gestating Sow, Lactating Sow) long putim ol standet nutrien rikwaemen.
Guide.guide_feed_step2_tip: Ol buai i save gro i nidim planti krud protin (16-18%) winim ol buai i gat bel (12-14%).
Guide.guide_feed_step3_desc: Putim ol samting olsem Maiz, Soya Meal, Wit Bran, Fishmeal, na Premix. Skelim ol pesen inap long ol 'nutrient bar' i kamap grin.
Guide.guide_feed_step3_tip: Mekim gut olsem 'Calcium to Phosphorus' (Ca:P) resio i stap namel long 1.2:1 na 1.6:1 bilong helpim bun i kamap gut.
Guide.guide_feed_step4_desc: Sevim 'balanced recipe' bilong yu long kisim hariap, o logim wanpela 'mixed batch' long apdetim 'feed inventory' otomatik.
Guide.guide_feed_step4_tip: Miksim kaikai long wankain hap na putim long ol drai, antap palet long stopim aflatoxin na bagarap.
Guide.guide_feed_subtitle: Disainim ol kaikai we i no gat bikpela pe na i gat planti gutpela kaikai long en long olgeta hap bilong prodaksen.
Guide.guide_feed_title: Wokim na skelim gut ol kaikai
Guide.guide_finances_step1_desc: Raitim olgeta mani we ol i tromoi long fam we i stap long ol kategori bilong Fid, Veterineri, Leba, Yutiliti, na Mentenens.
Guide.guide_finances_step1_tip: Logim ol ekspens taim ol i baim ol samting bai ol kos analitik i stap gut.
Guide.guide_finances_step2_desc: Rekodim mani yu kisim long salim ol animal i stap laip, ol animal ol i kilim, ol animal bilong karim pikinini, o ol 'organic manure'.
Guide.guide_finances_step2_tip: Rekodim tupela samting, laip weit na laspela prais bilong wan wan kilo bilong bihainim ol mak bilong maket.
Guide.guide_finances_step3_desc: Lukluk gen long COP long wan wan kg na prais bilong Finisher Breakeven long meksua olsem olgeta wan wan transeksen i kamapim gutpela winmani.
Guide.guide_finances_step3_tip: Fid i mas makim 65-75% bilong olgeta prodaksen kos bilong yu. Daunim westim kaikai.
Guide.guide_finances_subtitle: Lukluk long ol ekspens, reveniu bilong ol sels, na skelim kos bilong prodaksen long wan wan kg.
Guide.guide_health_step1_desc: Yusim 'Disease Finder' tul long makim ol mak bilong sik (kus, pekpek wara, sua) wantaim ol sik bilong ol buai.
Guide.guide_health_step1_tip: Putim ol sik animal i go insait long ol 'quarantine pen' pastaim long yu statim tritmen.
Guide.guide_health_step1_title: Painimaut bilong ol mak bilong sik
Guide.guide_health_step2_desc: Rekodim ol marasin bilong kilim binatang o ol binatang jem na raitim gut ol de bilong lusim mit.
Guide.guide_health_step2_tip: Noken maketim o kilim wanpela animal pastaim long taim bilong kisim mit i pinis.
Guide.guide_health_step3_desc: Lukautim gut ol 'footbath' wantaim marasin bilong kilim ol binatang, bosim ol manmeri i kam long fam, klinim ol kar, na putim ol nupela stok long kwarentin inap 30 de.
Guide.guide_health_step3_tip: Biosekyuriti em i 10-pela taim moa isi long tritim wanpela sik i kamap.
Guide.guide_health_subtitle: Luksave long ol hevi bilong sik, bihainim ol tritmen protokol, na lukautim gut 'biosecurity'.
Guide.guide_health_title: Painim sik na sekyuriti bilong laip
Guide.guide_herd_step1_desc: Go insait long 'Herd Data' long bikpela 'dashboard' o 'drawer menu' bilong lukim olgeta 'herd registry' bilong yu.
Guide.guide_herd_step1_tip: Yu ken sekim ol rekot bilong ol animal long 'status' (Active, Sold, Cull) yusim ol 'status tab'.
Guide.guide_herd_step2_desc: Taitim '+' floting baten. Putim ol bikpela infomesen: Tag ID, Breed, Sex, Birth Deit, na Pen i stap.
Guide.guide_herd_step2_tip: Givim ol klia, standet tag ID (e.g., SOW-001, BOAR-01) bilong isi long bihainim olgeta fam.
Guide.guide_herd_step3_desc: Opim 'profile card' bilong olgeta animal long kisim ol hevi bilong skel, ol sut, 'deworming', o ol marasin.
Guide.guide_herd_step3_tip: Skelim hevi bilong bodi oltaim i helpim long skelim stretpela 'Average Daily Gain' (ADG) na painimaut sik hariap.
Guide.guide_herd_step4_desc: Grupim ol buai we i wok long gro i go insait long ol banis o ol 'batch grup' bilong sekim gut namba bilong ol buai na hamas kaikai ol i kisim.
Guide.guide_herd_step4_tip: Noken putim ol banis we i pulap tumas long stopim pasin bilong kaikaim na mekim animal i gro wankain.
Guide.guide_herd_step4_title: Givim ol pen na ol lain
Guide.guide_herd_subtitle: Rejistretim ol animal, lukautim ol 'ear tag', makim ol 'pen', na bihainim lain bilong ol.
Guide.guide_hr_step1_desc: Rejistretim ol wokman, ol menesa bilong fam, na ol dokta bilong ol animal i gat rait long go insait long wok bilong ol.
Guide.guide_hr_step1_tip: Pasin bilong pasim ol edmin na menesa long kisim mani i save lukautim ol sensitif rekot.
Guide.guide_hr_step1_title: Putim ol memba bilong tim na givim ol wok
Guide.guide_hr_step2_desc: Givim ol wok bilong olgeta de olsem givim kaikai long banis, klinim wara, was long taim bilong karim bebi, na luksave long hat.
Guide.guide_hr_step2_tip: Ol klia 'task checklists' i stopim ol 'missed fieding' o 'delay' bilong kisim marasin.
Guide.guide_hr_step2_title: Givim ol wok na sediul bilong olgeta de
Guide.guide_hr_step3_desc: Raitim ol pe bilong pe, bonus, na ol didaksen long holim wanpela klia, oganais peirol histri.
Guide.guide_hr_step3_tip: Oltaim putim ol toksave long ol pefomens bonas o ol salari advans bilong mekim wok odit i kamap klia.
Guide.guide_hr_subtitle: Lukautim ol wokman, givim ol wok long olgeta de, bihainim namba bilong ol wokman i kam long wok, na raitim pe bilong ol.
Guide.guide_hr_title: Ol wokman na wok bilong fam
Guide.guide_intro_desc: Step-bai-step intaektiv wokflo bilong stretim helt bilong ol animal, wokim kaikai, taim bilong karim pikinini, mani, na menesmen bilong ol wokman.

Guide.guide_offline_step1_tip: Olgeta senis i stap long seif oflain databes bilong divais bilong yu.
Guide.guide_offline_step2_desc: Taim intanet i kamap gut gen, olgeta oflain apdet i save wok wantaim klaut databes.

Guide.guide_weight_step1_desc: Taim skel i no stap, skelim 'heart girth' baksait long fran lek na longpela bilong en stat long yau i go inap long as bilong tel.
Guide.guide_weight_step1_tip: Holim gut 'measuring tape' long skin bilong buai na noken presim mit bilong en.
Guide.guide_weight_step2_desc: SmartSwine i save kompyutim ADG namel long ol 'weighings' bilong lukluk long groa trajektori wantaim ol standet mak.
Guide.guide_weight_step2_tip: Taget ADG bilong ol komesel groa em 650g - 850g/de aninit long gutpela kaikai.
Guide.guide_weight_step3_desc: Lukim deit bilong kilim kaikai long maket (mak 90-100kg) long plenim baset bilong kaikai na kirapim ol baia long salim.
Guide.guide_weight_step3_tip: Planim ol 'finisher sales' bilong yu pastaim long kisim ol gutpela agrimen bilong ol baia.
Guide.guide_weight_subtitle: Skelim hevi bilong buai, bihainim spit bilong gro, na tingim ol de bilong kilim.
